description: Stable, non-time-sensitive factual claims used to measure end-to-end true/false verdict accuracy.

claims.claim: The Earth orbits the Sun.
Light travels faster than sound in air.
Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy.
The Moon has weaker surface gravity than Earth.
Water molecules contain hydrogen and oxygen atoms.
Antibiotics do not treat viral infections such as influenza.
A typical adult human skeleton has 206 bones.
The human heart has four chambers.
DNA carries genetic instructions in most living organisms.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
Mount Everest has the highest elevation above sea level of any mountain on Earth.
Venus has a higher average surface temperature than Mercury.
Humans use only 10 percent of their brains.
The Great Wall of China is visible from the Moon with the naked eye.
Bats are blind.
A goldfish has a memory of only three seconds.
Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
Earth's seasons happen because Earth is much closer to the Sun in summer than in winter.
Antibiotics can cure influenza.
Swallowed chewing gum stays in the human stomach for seven years.
Vaccines contain tracking microchips.
Sound travels faster than light.
Water boils at exactly 100 degrees Celsius at every altitude on Earth.
All deserts on Earth are hot.
